title: Double-Diffusion: Balancing Speed, Accuracy, and Uncertainty in Probabilistic Forecasting for Urban Sensor Networks
abstract: arXiv:2506.23053v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Urban sensor networks need forecasts that are accurate, carry useful uncertainty, and refresh fast enough to act on as new readings arrive. These goals conflict: deterministic models give no distribution, while diffusion forecasters model uncertainty but denoise from pure noise over many steps. We present Double-Diffusion, which integrates a closed-form graph-heat prior into a denoising diffusion model. The prior is a parameter-free low-pass forecast over the sensor graph, and it serves two roles: it is the residual target the model generates, and it conditions the denoiser. The reverse process therefore starts near the prior and denoises a short warm-started chain instead of synthesizing from pure noise; the name denotes this composition, a graph diffusion feeding a denoising diffusion. translated_title: 双重扩散：在城市传感器网络概率预测中平衡速度、准确性与不确定性
translated_abstract: 城市传感器网络需要这样的预测：既准确、又携带有用的不确定性信息，并且能在新读数到达时足够快速地更新以供决策行动。然而这些目标相互冲突：确定性模型无法给出分布，而扩散预测器虽能建模不确定性，却需要从纯噪声出发经过多步去噪。我们提出Double-Diffusion（双重扩散），它将一个闭式图热传导先验整合到去噪扩散模型中。该先验是传感器图上的一种无参数低通预测，承担双重角色：它既是模型生成的残差目标，又对去噪器进行条件化。因此，反向过程从先验附近开始，对一条较短的热启动链进行去噪，而非从纯噪声合成；其名称即表示这种组合——由图扩散馈入去噪扩散。一个紧凑的去噪器DD-Net按照去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）在Resfusion热启动框架下训练，因此生成过……
tldr: Double-Diffusion通过将闭式图热传导先验嵌入去噪扩散模型，使反向过程从先验附近热启动而非纯噪声出发，从而在城市传感器网络概率预测中实现了速度、准确性与不确定性的平衡。
en_tdlr: Double-Diffusion integrates a closed-form graph-heat prior into a denoising diffusion model, warm-starting the reverse process near the prior instead of pure noise to balance speed, accuracy, and uncertainty in probabilistic forecasting for urban sensor networks.
